cover.title: When does discharge planning start?
cover.kicker: If it starts on discharge day, it has already failed.

lines.say: Pause. Is it discharge day, or admission? It's admission.
Plan from day one, not the morning they leave.
Use teach-back. Ask them to explain it, not, do you understand?
And check equipment and supports are really in place before they go.
In Australia, aged care supports come through My Aged Care, and disability supports through the N D I S.
